ayahs.tj: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ١
ayahs.en: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.

ayahs.tj: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ ٢
ayahs.en: [All] praise is [due] to Allah, Lord of the worlds -
The Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful,

ayahs.tj: مَـٰلِكِ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ ٤
ayahs.en: Sovereign of the Day of Recompense.

ayahs.tj: إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ ٥
ayahs.en: It is You we worship and You we ask for help.
Guide us to the straight path -

ayahs.ar: صِرٰطَ الَّذينَ أَنعَمتَ عَلَيهِم غَيرِ المَغضوبِ عَلَيهِم وَلَا الضّالّينَ
ayahs.tj: صِرَٲطَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا ٱلضَّآلِّينَ ٧
ayahs.en: The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, not of those who have evoked [Your] anger or of those who are astray.
